## 4.1.50 (HexGhoul): joining gangs

HexKagune 4.1.50 for Forge 1.20.1. Not tested in game. **Update the server and every client together** (protocol 122 to 123).

Your words: "Players are now able to join gangs as well, dialog with Ayato and with a quest you can join Aogiri tree, the player's name turns
dark red with a symbol on the left (symbol) (space) (name)"; the quest "Kill 5 CCG"; the Clowns through Roma, "A short chain"; "Custom
clown face"; and for every gang: "the gang will never attack the player again, even when hit, they will however help the player and
defend him against hostiles. IF the player kills over 10 members of his own gang, he will be banned from joining, tag removed and will be
attacked on sight."

**Joining:**
- **Aogiri Tree:** talk to Ayato, "I want to join Aogiri." He sets the test: **kill 5 CCG** (investigators or their ghoul division; the
  count shows over your hotbar). Go back to him: you're in.
- **The Clowns:** talk to Roma, "I want to join the Clowns." **Make her laugh**: pick one of three jokes (the dark one lands; the others
  you can try again later). Then **kill 3 Gas Masks**, then **hand her an investigator's quinque case** (any quinque's case, in your hand).
- One gang at a time: each turns you away while you're in the other.

**Your name:** "(emblem) (space) (name)", in chat and over your head, on every client: **Aogiri's tree with your name in dark red**, **the
Clowns' face with your name in blue**. The emblems are their own colours.

**Being a member:**
- Your gang **never goes for you again**, not even when you hit them (no grudge, nobody called).
- They **defend you**: anything going for you near them (a mob after you, whatever last hurt you) they go for.
- **Kill more than 10 of your own** and you're **banned**: out of the gang, your tag gone, and they attack you on sight. Each kill of your
  own is counted to you over your hotbar.
- Kept with you through death and logging out.

### Other

- The emblems: `docs/handoff/gang-emblems-4.1.50.png` (16 x 16 each, added to the game's own font as two private characters).
- Next on your list: the new CCG tower, the reputation bar, gang traits and daily quests, the Gas Masks (Banjou), a "Quit the gang" option,
  marriage and gangs, then the menus.
